notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.notes:
Tired of ever sunny weather in misty world? Try the new night mode to turn the levels into Halloween mysterious lands!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/358bbc8e7fe6c70eb8e78c964c08bf03deca6510.png

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xFalwF6QJcg

Accessible with latest update via settings menu, checkbox Night Mode, turn it on/off whenever you like, not affecting gameplay nor achievements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/5301f36160bf3726f046be65cd822df66eeb091e.png

Enjoy!

Yours,
Boris

notes.title: Patch 1.03 (zoom and shift)
notes.notes:
Dear players,

today I've shipped one small update of how zooming and shifting works: 


You can now shift diagonally not only along axes
Now the speed depends on how close camera is to the level (closer -> slower) making it easier to navigate
Additionally bug with shifting working incorrectly with camera rotated heavily from initial position was fixed


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/27fe2135f63f03eda802e74a24539207e53b92e3.png

Now I plan to prepare a pack of fresh new levels (and free as promised), so stay tuned!

Yours,
Boris

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

A few issues have been identified by the helpful community (or me) and addressed lately. Please update the game to the latest version (check there are no scheduled updates in Downloads or restart Steam):

Changes:

 FIX: rarely knights got stuck during navigation, mainly in randomized levels, resulting in level needed to be restarted
 FIX: sometimes knight animation was warping back a bit, non game breaking
 TWEAK: level 60 removed unintentional tree covering road (was solvable anyway)
 TWEAK: level 70 was unintentionally made much harder, tweaked now, original version can be found in Levels/Level Stack for those who like the challenge :)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/d3eba2eeab9afa7a75ad875bf7b5d7ff11815152.png
Swapping these two tiles makes a lot of difference, believe me, harder version is solvable but requires an alternate route search :)

In case you run into any problems with the game, don't hesitate to contact me, I'll do my best to make it better!

Have fun!

Yours,
Boris
